name: agentic-plugins
description: Cross-host AI agent collaboration framework — Claude Code & Codex CLI

plugins.name: attention
plugins.description: Attention sensors — hook-only L1 plugin pushing operator notifications (approval prompts, idle prompts, turn/workflow terminals, subagent completion) from Claude Code lifecycle hooks into the runtime notification emitter (ADR-0040 §3). Hooks + sensor scripts only; fail-closed silent observers; inert until the operator opts into a notify_channel via runtime:settings. No Codex hooks at v1.

plugins.name: companions
plugins.description: First-party Claude/Codex companion bridges and companion discovery library per companions/contract.md v0.1.1

plugins.name: engineer
plugins.description: Engineer workbench for AI-assisted engineering across Claude Code & Codex CLI — 6 cognitive verbs (investigate / frame / decide / compose / critique / refine), /engineer:start lifecycle macro, 3 workflow-continuity meta skills (resume / checkpoint / peer-now), and cited-brief research profile.

plugins.name: founder
plugins.description: Founder workbench for AI-assisted new-business planning across Claude Code & Codex CLI — business-item discovery, ideation, concretization, and planning composition through the six cognitive verbs (ADR-0036). The second L3 persona after engineer: workflow machinery, hooks, all six verb surfaces (investigate / frame / decide / compose / critique / refine), the business ensemble protocol, the founder:start lifecycle macro, and the resume / checkpoint / peer-now meta skills — all shipped (ADR-0036 Accepted).

plugins.name: image
plugins.description: Image capability — cross-host image generation via Codex's integrated gpt-image tool through the companion bridge. L2 capability plugin per ADR-0010 4-layer composition (ADR-0037). Six cognitive verbs (investigate / frame / decide / compose / critique / refine); generation runs only through Codex's integrated gpt-image (never a direct OpenAI API call), with the Claude host dispatching through the codex-companion bridge.

plugins.name: orchestrator
plugins.description: Macro orchestration capability — multi-deliverable plan + Plan-verify ensemble + same-host dispatch into engineer, lifecycle closure, and workflow-continuity meta surfaces for AI-assisted development across Claude Code & Codex CLI. L2 capability plugin per ADR-0010 4-layer composition (ADR-0018 §sub-decision-1, ADR-0019 cross-plugin invocation).

plugins.name: runtime
plugins.description: Runtime operator control plane for agentic-plugins host readiness, doctor diagnostics, settings planning, workflow storage migration, consensus artifacts, compatibility drift planning, worktree planning, context hygiene artifacts, model/effort config, companion readiness, and workflow ledger health. L1 framework primitive per ADR-0024.
